resources.string: Connect to Poruneko on your PC
Turn on remote access in the PC\'s settings and enter one of the addresses it shows (through NordVPN Meshnet or Tailscale, the one starting with 100.).
Enter an address such as http://100.x.x.x:47392/
Could not reach the PC (%1$s): %2$s. Check that Poruneko is running on it and that this device is on the same network or VPN.
